title: No teacher daily hour maximum
text: There is no hard maximum number of teaching hours per day unless a teacher-specific rule says otherwise.

title: 15-minute scheduling grid
text: Schedule start and end times on 15-minute increments.

title: Studio A profile
text: Studio A is the second-largest room, has Marley flooring, and is ideal for Ballet, Jazz, Lyrical, and Contemporary. Tap or Hip Hop are possible but not ideal.

title: Ballet Levels 1-5 require Studio A
text: Ballet 1, Ballet 2, Ballet 3, Ballet 4A, Ballet 4A/4B, Ballet 4B/5, and Ballet 5 must be scheduled in Studio A.

title: Pointe requires Studio A
text: Pre-Pointe, Pointe 1, and Pointe 2/3 must be scheduled in Studio A.

title: Studio B profile
text: Studio B is the largest room, has wood flooring, is suitable for most subjects, and is particularly useful for Jazz, Tap, Contemporary, Hip Hop, and Company Technique. It is not the preferred Ballet room.

title: Studio A/B current capacity
text: No relevant hard capacity limit is currently needed for Studio A or Studio B with current enrollment.

title: Studio C profile
text: Studio C is the smallest room, has wood flooring, and is generally preferred for Combo, Elementary, Adult, and Tap where appropriate.

title: Studio C normal practical capacity
text: For non-Elementary classes, approximately 15 dancers is the practical maximum for Studio C unless explicitly changed later.

title: Elementary Studio C capacity exception
text: Elementary classes may exceed the normal 15-dancer Studio C practical limit.

title: Elementary Ballet uses Studio C
text: Elementary Ballet classes should be scheduled in Studio C and are currently treated as a hard room requirement.

title: Combo prefers Studio C
text: Combo classes should be scheduled in Studio C when practical.

title: Elementary prefers Studio C
text: Elementary classes should generally be scheduled in Studio C when practical, except where another hard rule controls.

title: Adult prefers Studio C
text: Adult classes should generally be scheduled in Studio C when practical.

title: Tap prefers wood rooms
text: Tap classes should preferably use Studio B or Studio C.
